newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel says accepts resignation of CFO.
newsitem.headline: Piltel says accepts resignation of CFO.

text.p: Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) said on Tuesday that Ignatius Yenko, its chief financial officer, had resigned effective February 15.
It said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange that the resignation had been accepted.
The Manila Times newspaper said Yenko had submitted his resignation because of a 740-million-peso writeoff in the 1996 year due to subscriber fraud and cloning.
Piltel said earlier this month that it expects net income in 1996 to reach around 700 million pesos despite the provision of 887 million pesos for doubtful accounts.
The doubtful accounts include the 740 million pesos written off as bad debts.
